summary: SOL Strategies Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Jon Matonis as Chairman of the Board, effective May 11, 2026. Matonis resigned as Chief Economist effective May 12, 2026. This is a leadership change that includes the departure of a director-level officer, not a routine meeting notice. The new chairman is a founding director of the Bitcoin Foundation. No financial terms, recommendations, or deal structure are provided. The registrant is the issuer. Monitor for any strategic shifts in corporate governance or additional appointments.
